items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: So John said, 'Forget it; listen to her play.' So we went on with that and everything was fine. About 6 months or a year later Seymour died and John Williams and the combo and I worked with Jeanette for a while till we were stranded in New York.

ctx.x: Yes, I was... He had a small combo, it was the most terrific thing you've ever heard in your life. See, John was the first musician that ever played a baritone and he was really in demand all over the country, everybody heard about him. But he chose to work with other people, you know, and he had his own little combo. We had a trombone player there that played more trombone with his foot than I hear today.
